name: Amakawa Chinatsu
source: Patron of "YuKuRu" and an acquaintance of [url=/c66131]Inaho Shin[/url]. In high school, she worked part-time under Shin and [url=/c66132]Kyouko[/url] at a traditional Japanese restaurant called "Fuuryuuan" and she still works part-time there as a university student. She's not particularly happy about Kyouko leaving, as she feels she has big shoes to fill in her absence. She says "Nanodesu" pretty often; [url=/c64630]Yuzuri[/url] calls her "Nanodesu-san."
